defect.description: The backtester calls trade_pnl independently for each cost multiplier. Because trade_pnl includes the admission threshold, the 1.5x and 2x trade sets are reselected instead of holding the 1x trade set fixed.
defect.consequence: Reported higher-cost PnL can increase because marginal losing trades disappear. The metric is a re-optimized admission frontier, not robustness of the executed trade set.
defect.observed_symptom: The current GDELT 1h candidate reports 0.41 PnL/share at 1x but 0.545 at 1.5x despite higher costs.
defect.promotion_impact: Do not interpret positive 1.5x/2x values as cost robustness until frozen-trade stress is computed. q_external remains fail-closed.

successor_contract.required_ablation: same chronological decisions with and without external feature
successor_contract.coordination: Complements PR #385, which owns the separate midpoint-target versus horizon-executable-hurdle defect; do not duplicate that work.
successor_contract.promotion_gate: No external candidate is evidence-ready until frozen-trade stress, exact-CLOB replay, bootstrap and fold-stability gates all pass.
